title: MediCore HMS — clinical dashboard redesign
brief: Redesign the MediCore HMS frontend, which currently renders as a centred Vite scaffold: professional hospital-dashboard look for front desk and clinical staff, modelled on MedLink-style healthcare admin dashboards. Same screen in every direction (agenda + today) so the comparison is structural, not cosmetic.

artboards.title: 01 · Dark sidebar, KPI row, schedule table
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to the reference and instantly legible for front-desk staff; the KPI row costs vertical space and needs data the app can only partly source today.

artboards.title: 02 · Light topbar, week grid as the hero
artboards.tradeoff: Time is the primary axis, so availability and gaps read at a glance; the grid is the most expensive screen to build and degrades on narrow screens.

artboards.title: 03 · Icon rail, master–detail console
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for working one appointment at a time and scales to long lists; denser and less welcoming, and it hides cross-professional overview.

artboards.title: 04 · CHOSEN — 01 structure with 03 palette
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the legible front-desk layout while the ink-and-teal palette removes the 'generic admin template' feel; still needs a real Today screen so the KPI row is not decorative.
